text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It seems I've gotten injured. ...I 
apologize. Everything that happened is 
entirely my fault.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I sensed the danger. After all, it is my 
own body."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I couldn't bring myself to stop. 
...I desired to transcend my very 
'limits.'
choice_data_list: Let's take it easy and go at our own pace.
You can definitely push past your limits!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Self-reflection—if one wishes to 
surpass oneself, one must first know 
oneself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A stride beyond one's means cannot be 
maintained. I shall take that lesson 
deeply to heart.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Whatever heights must be reached, I shall 
attain them. If that is my duty as the 
"Emperor."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Still... it's rather frustrating that it 
isn't something that can happen right 
away..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh... How disgraceful of me. I've shown 
you a pathetic side of myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, with such a weak mindset, 
there is no way I could possibly surpass 
my limits, huh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even if I cannot move my body for a while, 
there is no limit to the mental training I 
can do...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm awake now. Trainer... you have my 
thanks!
